features.name: contact_intensity
features.description: Measures the intensity of the current campaign relative to previous interactions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous ratio that helps the linear model weigh the effort of the current campaign against historical engagement.

features.name: recent_contact_indicator
features.description: Indicates whether the client was contacted in a recent campaign prior to the current one.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a clear linear separation between clients with recent historical interactions and those without.

features.name: duration_per_campaign
features.description: Calculates the logarithmic duration of the last contact divided by the number of contacts performed during this campaign.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes the interaction time by the number of attempts, offering a smooth continuous measure of interaction depth.

features.name: age_normalized
features.description: Standardizes the client's age using the training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves SVM margin optimization by scaling the demographic feature to a standard normal range.

features.name: interest_rate_burden
features.description: Combines the Euribor 3-month rate with the client's loan status to estimate financial burden.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a weighted composite feature that captures the interaction between macroeconomic rates and individual debt.

features.name: previous_engagement_score
features.description: Scores the historical engagement by weighting the number of previous contacts by the recency of the last contact.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers a continuous severity measure of past engagement, allowing the linear model to capture historical relationship strength.

features.name: campaign_frequency
features.description: Estimates the frequency of campaign contacts relative to the month of the year.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous ratio that helps the model understand campaign density over time.

features.name: housing_loan_interaction
features.description: Creates a linear combination of housing and personal loan status.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear SVM to capture the additive effect of multiple loan types on the client's financial profile.

features.name: education_age_ratio
features.description: Calculates the ratio of education level to age.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth normalized score representing educational attainment relative to life stage.

features.name: client_stability_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of the client's overall stability based on age, job, marital status, education, default, housing, and loan.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-linear socio-economic stability patterns into a single continuous score suitable for linear weighting.

features.name: macroeconomic_favorability
features.description: Semantic evaluation of how favorable the current macroeconomic indicators are for financial commitments.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates complex macroeconomic conditions into a smooth, interpretable score that aligns with linear decision boundaries.

features.name: engagement_quality
features.description: Semantic judgment of the quality of the client's engagement based on duration, campaign, pdays, previous, and poutcome.
features.expected_model_benefit: Synthesizes interaction metrics into a holistic quality measure, providing a strong linear predictor of engagement success.
